newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
An estimated $50 million dredging project for the river Gorai, the only sweet water carrying stream in the southern region, is underway.
Jatiya Party on Tuesday withdrew expulsion order on presidium member and former Prime Minister Kazi Zafar Ahmed.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Begum Khaleda Zia on Tuesday accused the ruling Awami League of trying to introduce one-party rule in the country.

The draft Strategic Plan for the national AIDS programme has set targets of keeping the prevalence of HIV infection below one percent among women in economically active ages and below five percent among commercial sex workers by the year 2,000.
The hearing of prosecution witnesses of the muder case of independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was adjourned on Tuesday till May 6.
Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed on Tuesday called for separating economic agenda from politics to accelerate pace of development.
Business leaders have suggested immediate confidence building steps to salvage the capital market.

Mistrust and lack of information are major issues need to be addressed urgently for an effective sub-regional grouping in the eastern Himalayan region, participants at a regional workshop on Tuesday observed REUTER
